rules.title: A failure the caller needed is not swallowed
rules.text: A script reports the failures it cannot handle: `|| true` and an empty `except` turn a broken run into a green one, and the log reader cannot tell the two apart. A best-effort step that may fail says so where it fails.

judgement.question: Does this hide a failure the caller or the log needed to see, rather than a best-effort step whose failure cannot matter?

criteria.true: the failure is discarded and nothing records it
criteria.false: the failure is reported or asserted on, or the line is cleanup whose failure cannot change the result
